description:
Animate the 'SpeakerCone' object to react to music using Blender's audio visualization tools.

Goal: Bake the sound wave from the provided audio file into the Z-axis Scale of the SpeakerCone object.

Steps:
1. Select the 'SpeakerCone' object.
2. Insert a keyframe on the Scale property (ensure Z-axis is keyed) to initialize the animation channel.
3. Open the Graph Editor.
4. Use the 'Bake Sound to F-Curves' operator (Key > Bake Sound to F-Curves) on the Z Scale channel.
5. Select the audio file located at '/home/ga/assets/beat.wav'.
6. Save the project to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/visualizer_completed.blend'.

Starting State: Blender is open with the scene loaded. The audio file is ready in the assets folder.
